neighbours.label: ' per' as a rate word after a measured quantity ('60 calories per tablespoon')
fire: This syrup has around 60 calories per tablespoon, more than honey.
Engineers say the panel yields 15 liters of water per square meter.
The mine consumes 2 million liters of water per day.
A serving of this cereal has 110 calories per cup.
The plant produces 40 tons of steel per hour at full speed.
Each bottle contains 8 milligrams of caffeine per ounce.
The dam releases 500 cubic meters of water per second.
The bar contains about 200 calories per piece of chocolate.
